rule.description: Sort the 683 processed_scannetpp_v2 scene directory names. perm = numpy.random.default_rng(42).permutation(683). The scenes at perm[:int(0.9 * 683)] = perm[:614] are train; the remaining 69 are val. The excluded scenes are then removed.

universe_sha256_definition: sha256 over the canonical units sorted by (scene_id, streaming_window_id); each unit contributes compact sorted-key JSON of {scene_id, split, streaming_window_id, streaming_window_indices} followed by a newline. See universe_sha256() in scripts/build_tstep_canonical_manifests.py.
notes: The public source is the original prefix-24 canonical manifest (parent_manifest_sha256, not shipped) with the storage fields scene_dir, streaming_feature_root and target_feature_root removed. All other fields and the row order are unchanged.
scripts/build_tstep_canonical_manifests.py build expands the public source into the prefix-8/12/16/24 manifests and fails unless the universe hash matches universe_sha256.
Per-prefix manifest file hashes differ from the manifests used for the original runs because the built rows no longer embed storage paths. Sample identity is fixed by universe_sha256.

Without INSCENE_MANIFEST the dataset loader applies the same rule to the scenes it finds at runtime (682 directories with images in a complete download), which puts 8 of the 681 scenes in the other split. Train and evaluate from the built manifests.
There is no held-out test split. All reported numbers are on val.
